name: Jellywave
description: Adds a Live Radio tile to My Media. Each station is an item in it: SUB/WAVE stations with now playing, covers and the optional station page, and plain MP3, AAC or HLS streams. Open the tile, press play, hear the station.
overview: Live Radio: SUB/WAVE stations and internet radio streams as a My Media tile.

versions.changelog: Requires Jellyfin 12.4; earlier Jellywave versions are no longer offered. Live Radio: the SUB/WAVE tile becomes a 'Live Radio' tile with a station list, for SUB/WAVE stations and plain MP3, AAC and HLS streams. Add a station by pasting a URL and pressing Check. A fresh install starts with five stations; upgrades get none. Every station now plays through Jellyfin: each listener runs one ffmpeg on the server, and users need 'Allow audio playback that requires transcoding'. The optional station page follows what plays, shows plain streams' titles, and replaces pause with Stop. A SUB/WAVE station is asked for now playing only while someone listens. Safer settings: a save swaps in a complete new file and keeps the last one as .previous; an unreadable file is copied aside, never overwritten, and the page says so. New per-user limits on station calls, likes and song requests, with a 'try again in N s' on the page. Animated images are refused. A station on a publicly known id gets a new random id once, so its favourites and play state are reset. The plugin page warns that tile access hides the tile but does not lock it, warns about secrets in a stream URL, and asks before a tile rename. Never put secrets in stream URLs: signed-in users can read them. Security fix: stream URLs now reach ffmpeg escaped, so a quote in an admin-entered URL can no longer add ffmpeg options (0.1.0.0 to 0.4.2.0 are affected; admin configuration only). Upgrading from 0.4.x: press 'Give them access to the renamed tile' on the plugin page, run 'Refresh Channels', and see the README.

Station page: signing out, or signing in as another user or on another server, clears what the page showed before; a station that becomes unavailable to you (access removed, channel renamed) takes its header and drawer link away; the like button no longer sends the previous track's like after a track change; the page does less work on every screen change in the web client.

Changing the station URL no longer mixes the old station's schedule, recent tracks or cover art into the new one; a track without cover art is rechecked every 30 minutes instead of on every poll; an empty now-playing answer from the station counts as a failure and the tile falls back to its default text; a schedule with a repeated show or host id, or a station list with an empty entry, no longer breaks the station page.

Requires Jellyfin 12.3. Station page routes now answer only users who can see the channel and refuse API keys; a request's status is visible only to the user who sent it; station redirects are refused; station URLs with credentials, a query or a fragment are refused and the config page says why; covers are checked by content; a channel name clash with another plugin stops Jellywave instead of touching the other channel; access grants run one at a time; the 'visible to every user' setting is now a one-shot button and no longer re-adds the station after an admin removes it.
Takeovers detected by show id; poller status reads as one snapshot and says when it is waiting for the first poll.
Poller status on the plugin page; schedule honours the station's takeovers; small page tidy-ups.
Station page layout: cover, now playing and the request box side by side, panels in a row; a refused like keeps the heart; schedule keeps its clock.
Station page extras: DJ portrait, up next, recently played, like button, today's programme, lyrics panel when the station enables them.
Cover art and what is up next on the live item; optional station page (needs the File Transformation plugin) with live track, DJ, show, requests, and a playing bar that follows the track.
Make the station visible to every user from the plugin page (off by default); new users and policy saves are covered.
